reason: My statin handles my cholesterol and I already know to order the grilled fish or the salad. I don't need a phone app to tell me what I already do on autopilot.
objection: If I'm honest, I don't trust a photo of a menu to catch what matters, like butter or cream hidden in a sauce, and I'd still be guessing whether the app is right.
would_change_my_mind: If it showed me that the grilled fish I always order is actually cooked in butter or cream, something I had no idea about, and I could fix it with one swap.
